results.note: Collectio decretorum pontificum Romanorum - a technical papal legislative collection. No complete English translation found; papal decrees appear only in fragmentary NPNF coverage and specialized journal articles, not as a unified published work.

Vita S. Caesarii - W.E. Klingshirn's "Caesarius of Arles: Life, Testament, Letters" (Translated Texts for Historians, Liverpool University Press, 1994). This is a modern scholarly translation in the TTH series.

Variae - M. Shane Bjornlie's complete translation published by UC Press (2019). Also an earlier abridged condensed translation by Thomas Hodgkin (1886), but Bjornlie is the definitive complete modern English translation.

Annales Francici - The Royal Frankish Annals (Annales regni Francorum) have an English translation by Scholz & Rogers (1970, University of Michigan Press), but uncertain if the specific PL volume 71 collection is the same text or a different compilation of Frankish annals.
Appendix (volumes 71, 88, 141) - Generic appendix materials across multiple Migne volumes. No identified English translation for such miscellaneous appendicial material.

Praeludia in vitam Sancti Pauli, primi eremitae (200 words) - Small introductory work to Jerome's Life of Paul the First Hermit. While Jerome's Vita itself has multiple English translations (NPNF Fremantle 1893, White 1998), no separate translation of these short praeludia was found.
Praeludium (214 words, vol 74) - A brief prefatory/introductory work. No English translation found in standard patristic collections or scholarly sources.
Documenta varia - Miscellaneous ecclesiastical documents. No comprehensive English translation identified; these materials rarely appear in published English translation collections.

Concilia Africae - African councils are included in NPNF Series 2, Vol. 14 (Henry R. Percival's translation, 1899). This covers the Council of Carthage (419) and related African synods. NPNF is public domain.

Concilia Galliae - Councils of Gaul from the Migne collection. Search results show modern critical Latin editions (e.g., Clercq/Munier in CCSL), but no complete English translation found. NPNF2-14 does not comprehensively cover Gallic councils.
Concilia Graeciae - Councils from Greece/Eastern regions. These appear as separate Latin scholarly collections (CCSL editions) with no published comprehensive English translation.

Concilia Hispaniae - Spanish/Iberian councils. Despite NPNF2-14 references to some Councils of Toledo, the comprehensive Concilia Hispaniae collection from Migne has no complete English translation identified.

Epistolae decretales - Papal decretals. A blog translation exists for papal letters from the Saeculum Obscurum (904-964) from Migne vols 131-133, but unclear if this covers the full scope of decretals in vol 84 or is a subset.
Analecta - Miscellaneous scattered texts/fragments from vol 87. No English translation identified for such small analytical collections.
Appendix II (volumes 87, 99) - Appendix materials across Migne volumes. No identified English translation.
Diplomata ecclesiastica - Ecclesiastical diplomatic documents/charters. Medieval charters and diplomata are studied in scholarly works but no English translation of this specific collection found.

Formulae diversae - Miscellaneous medieval formula collection. While medieval formulae are well-studied (e.g., Formulae Marculfi), no English translation of this specific diverse formulae collection identified.

Diplomata regis Francorum - Charters/diplomatic documents of Frankish kings. Scholarly Latin editions exist (MGH Diplomata), but no comprehensive English translation of this specific Migne collection found.
Diplomata (volumes 89, 141, 185) - Miscellaneous diplomatic documents across multiple Migne volumes. No unified English translation identified.
Monumenta contemporanea - Contemporary (to the Early Middle Ages) historical monuments/documents. No identified English translation in scholarly collections.
Homiliae de Sanctis - Medieval homiliary collection for saints' days. No complete English translation found; searches of CCEL and other patristic databases did not locate an English version.
Homiliae de tempore - Medieval homiliary collection for liturgical seasons/times. Despite these being important medieval preaching texts, no complete English translation identified.
Annotationes in operibus Bedae - Annotations on the works of Bede, likely medieval scholarly commentary. Latin text exists on Wikisource, but no English translation located.
Diplomata (vol 96) - Diplomatic documents. No specific English translation identified; these are studied in Latin in specialist medieval history work.
Appendix ad epistolas (vol 98) - Appendix to epistles. No identified English translation.

Epistolae pontificum Romanorum - Papal letters. A blog post documents a complete translation of papal letters from 904-964 (from Migne vols 131-133), but the broader vol 98 collection status is unclear; may be partially or unevenly translated.
Appendix I (vol 99) - Appendix material. No identified English translation.
Canones selecti - Selected canons from church councils. While individual NPNF canons are translated, no complete English translation of this specific Migne selection identified.
Chartularium Werthinense - Monastic cartulary/charter collection. Medieval cartularies are studied in Latin; no English translation of this specific monastery's chartularium identified.
Fragmenta ex codicibus manuscriptis (309 words) - Brief fragments from medieval manuscripts. Too small and scattered to have a published English translation.
Fragmenta ex collectoribus canonum - Fragments from canon law collections. No English translation identified.
Dogmatica - Ecclesiastical dogmatic/theological texts. General medieval theology is studied in Latin; no specific English translation of this vol 101 collection identified.
Historica - Historical chronicles/narratives (vol 101). While various medieval histories have English translations, no translation of this specific Migne historical collection identified.
Preces sacrae - Sacred prayers/liturgical material. While individual medieval prayers appear in scholarly works, no complete English translation of this specific prayer collection identified.
Chartae Ludovici Pii et Lotharii - Charters of Louis the Pious and Lothair I. Carolingian diplomata are studied in Latin (MGH editions); no English translation of these specific charters identified.

Liber diurnus Romanorum Pontificum - Papal formulary handbook. No English translation found; critical Latin editions (Holstenius 1650, de Rozière 1869) exist but no modern English translation located.
Testimonia de Theodulfo - Testimonies about Theodulph of Orleans. No English translation identified in biographical or historical sources about this 8th-9th century bishop and theologian.

Responsio episcoporum Germaniae contra Graecos - Response of German bishops against the Greeks (9th century theological controversy). No English translation identified despite the work's historical importance.
Privilegium monasterii Corbeiensis - Privilege/immunity charter for Corvey monastery. Medieval monastery privileges are studied in Latin; no English translation of this specific privilege identified.

Vetus Romanum martyrologium - Old Roman martyrology (pre-modern Martyrologium Romanum). The later official Roman Martyrology has modern English translations, but the Vetus (ancient) version specifically has no identified English translation.
Supplementum ad epistolas et diplomata pontificum Romanorum saec. IX - Supplement to papal letters/documents from the 9th century. No comprehensive English translation identified.
Appendix auctorum veterum - Appendix of ancient authors (vol 132). No English translation of such appendicial material identified.
Appendix ad historiam ecclesiae Remensis - Appendix to the history of the church of Reims. No English translation identified.
Testimonia et elogia (501 words) - Testimonies and eulogies/epithets. Too brief and specific; no English translation identified.
Chartularium S. Maioli (516 words) - Very brief monastic cartulary for St. Maiol/Mayeul of Cluny. No English translation identified.
